_about: Proposed additions to 06_data_streams/stream_catalog.json for the raw host logs of the utility (fork H, 2026-11-12). Generator: scripts/streams/gen_itsec_host.py (model in itsec_host_model.py); probes: scripts/streams/probes_itsec_host.py. expected_observation_count is 0 until the canon timeline lists these streams; the probe file already has probes for the events under suggested_expected_observations and invariant probes keyed INV-*.

add_streams.name: Windows event logs
add_streams.format: JSON Lines; Security, System and Defender channels of the utility's Windows hosts, forwarded subset of event ids
add_streams.cadence: one file per channel and month (split into _01, _02 when over 40 MB)
add_streams.notes: A forwarded subset of event ids. Interactive sessions and everything named by a SIEM alert, an audit-table row or a Zeek flow is complete; other background follows the Zeek sample. Starts 2027-07-15 (one day of lead-in, like the endpoint-protection table). Schema: schemas/windows_event_logs_schema.json.

add_streams.name: Endpoint telemetry
add_streams.format: JSON Lines; process, network, DNS, file, registry, service, task and removable-device events from the endpoint agent
add_streams.notes: One network_connect per Zeek conn row that starts at a Windows host (join on the 5-tuple, within 0.5 s) and one dns_query per Zeek dns row, so the background is the same 1-in-200 sample. Process exits are not recorded. Schema: schemas/endpoint_telemetry_schema.json.

add_streams.name: Host triage collections
add_streams.format: CSV tables, collection.json and inert text placeholders per collected host

key_columns.time: collection.json collected_utc; *_utc columns in the tables

add_streams.notes: Fourteen collections taken 2027-10-02 to 2027-10-14. Listings and hashes only; placeholders are text files whose SHA-256 equals the hash the logs record. Schema: schemas/host_triage_schema.json.

suggested_expected_observations.what: On the workstation: mail attachment written and started, real-time protection disabled, lookup and download, second file, service registered; afterwards every connection to the same address carries the service binary's image
Network logon, share reads and logoff on the historian replica from the workstation under the account of a person on leave; service ticket on a domain controller
Fourteen out-of-hours logons on the remote-access gateway with their source addresses; gateway and historian collected 2027-10-02
Remote-interactive logon on the SCADA server from the gateway at the time of the suppression-list change
Network logon and write of relayconfigs\sub02\rtu_config_draft.xml on the engineering file server from the gateway
Remote-interactive logon on the operator workstation from the gateway about 95 s before each breaker-open command
The workstation's collection agrees with the event logs (files, hashes, service)

size_note: windows_event_logs is about 275 MB (budget was 130 MB): 598,000 of its 1.0 million Security events are the 4625 records that back the 66,547 failed-logon-burst alerts one for one. See the fork report.
applied: 2026-11-12: streams added to stream_catalog.json; observations added to the MSEL (expected_observation_count in the catalogue is now set from canon_timeline.json)
